item.title: Sex work or starve: Aid workers in Nepal left jobless by USAID cuts turn to sex work to survive
item.description: She paces the side of the darkened highway in central Nepal, just enough light from the trucks roaring past to illuminate her painted face to the men rolling in on rickshaws and motorbikes.
